crossRefs.note: How much more, those who dwell in houses of clay, whose foundation is in the dust, who are crushed before the moth!
How much less man, who is a worm, the son of man, who is a worm!”
But will God in very deed dwell on the earth? Behold, heaven and the heaven of heavens can’t contain you; how much less…
For you say, ‘My doctrine is pure. I am clean in your eyes.’
But oh that God would speak, and open his lips against you,
I would set my cause in order before him, and fill my mouth with arguments.
There the upright might reason with him, so I should be delivered forever from my judge.
If you can, answer me. Set your words in order before me, and stand up.

translations.web: How much less will I answer him, And choose my words to argue with him?
translations.bsb: How then can I answer Him or choose my arguments against Him?
translations.kjv: How much less shall I answer him, and choose out my words
translations.asv: How much less shall I answer him, And choose out my words to reason with him?
